query: I feel like no matter how hard I try, nothing ever changes.
I have no energy to get out of bed in the morning.
I feel like everyone is moving forward while I remain stuck.
I wonder if the life I built is really the life I wanted.
I am terrified of what the future holds for me.
I am surrounded by people but feel completely alone.
I failed at the one thing I was supposed to be good at.
I am finally learning who I really am.
The feeling of peace I get when I watch the rain.
Sometimes I think about all the choices that brought me here.
